newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM shares jump as Dutch state cuts stake.
newsitem.headline: KLM shares jump as Dutch state cuts stake.

text.p: Shares in Dutch airline KLM jumped at the open on Thursday on news the state was reducing its holding in the flag carrier from 38.2 percent to 25 percent.
KLM is to buy back 17.3 million ordinary shares from the Dutch government.
KLM shares opened at 46.30 guilders after closing at 45.20 on Wednesday and swiftly moved ahead, adding 2.30 guilders, or 5.09 percent, by 0841 GMT.
"It was somewhat expected, there have been rumours since autumn," one Dutch analyst said.

"Since the rumours started the share price has gone up some 15 percent. With the changes, EPS will rise some 20 percent, so there is still room for around a five percent appreciation in the share price."
